engine: OriginPro Native (.opju + expGraph) & Cross-Discipline Declarative Chart Grammar

design_principles.box_and_typography: 3.0pt closed 4-side frame (1.6pt for insets, 1.8-2.2pt for multi-panel grids), bold Times New Roman or clean Arial Regular preset, native Origin XB/YL/YR GraphObjects.

minimal_tick_matrix.intensity_arbitrary: Left-Y ticks & numbers OFF; bottom-X inward major ticks ON; top/right ticks OFF.
minimal_tick_matrix.categorical: Bottom-X tick lines OFF (semantic sample labels ON, scientific colons preserved); left-Y inward major ticks ON.
minimal_tick_matrix.quantitative: Bottom-X & left-Y inward major ticks ON; minor ticks OFF except when scale == 'log10'.
minimal_tick_matrix.dual_y_left_and_right: Left-Y & right-Y inward major ticks ON, minor ticks OFF; Layer 1 sets y.showAxes=1; right-Y spine/ticks/YR bound to right-axis semantic color; zero baseline aligned.
minimal_tick_matrix.inset: 1.6pt frame, opaque #FFFFFF fill, parent-layer percentage bbox (Origin layer.unit=7), <=4 sparse inward major ticks, redundant axis titles omitted.

semantic_color_system.paired_semantic: Control/baseline uses paired blues (#3E86DE, #C5DBF5, #6579BE); pulse/treatment uses paired reds (#D84B5C, #A02333, #E8A3AF).
semantic_color_system.tol_muted: 10 discrete balanced colors for multi-cluster omics/ML (#332288, #88CCEE, #44AA99, #117733, #999933, #DDCC77, #CC6677, #882255, #AA4499, #6699CC).
semantic_color_system.perceptual_continuous: Perceptually uniform continuous & diverging ramps ('viridis', 'cividis', 'batlow', 'vik', 'magma') wired into both series interpolation and 1052-byte RIFF .pal colormaps.
semantic_color_system.sandwich_stack: Stacked columns use flat solid fills + 0.8pt #FFFFFF dividers (never per-segment gradients): bottom inert (#D8DEE9, #C5DBF5) -> middle conventional (#6579BE, #3E86DE) -> top active (#E8A3AF, #D84B5C, #A02333).
semantic_color_system.sequential_blue_red: >5 ordered physical curves interpolate across #2B6CB0 -> #3E86DE -> #6579BE -> #E8A3AF -> #D84B5C -> #A02333 (deep_blue_to_red for >=8 high-rate clusters).
semantic_color_system.pseudocolor_zero_white: 2D intensity/DRT maps force zero background to pure white #FFFFFF -> #C5DBF5 -> #6579BE -> #D84B5C -> #A02333 via 1052-byte RIFF .pal.

modes.summary: Single-group or multi-group vertical gradient column chart with SD error bars and bold same-hue top value labels.

origin_native_recipe.single_series: Diagonal sparse Y_i + YErr_i columns plotted individually with plot:=203 (ungrouped) + -pbc -4; optional .otpu gradient slot.

modes.summary: Absolute-sum stacked column chart with flat sandwich semantic bands and crisp 0.8pt white inter-band dividers.

origin_native_recipe.palette_injection: 1052B discrete RIFF .pal via plot1.colorlist (stretchpal=0); NEVER call gl.group() / layer -g.

modes.summary: Row-normalized 100% percentage stacked column chart for XPS/Raman species evolution and polarization fraction analysis.

Single-panel dual-Y overlay (e.g. left-Y elemental at.% lines with 3D spheres + right-Y 100% functional-group stacked bars, or capacity + Coulombic efficiency) with full-height zero alignment and right-axis color binding.

origin_native_recipe.layer_1: gl1: layer.x.showAxes=3; layer.y.showAxes=1 (suppresses duplicate right black spine).
origin_native_recipe.layer_2: gl2 = gp.add_layer(2) (linked Right-Y), YR & right ticks dyed with right_axis_color, interior upper-frame dual legend.

modes.summary: Main XY curve family with one or more zoom or sub-distribution insets, optional 1:1 square lock (equal_aspect), and main-panel zoom selection box.

origin_native_recipe.inset_layer: gl_in = gp.add_layer(6) with layer.unit=7 (% of Linked Parent Layer), opaque #FFFFFF fill, 1.6pt box.
origin_native_recipe.equal_aspect: Locks physical square layer dimensions (layer.unit=2; width=5.0; height=5.0) for Nyquist.

modes.summary: Unified electrochemical kinetics mode supporting subtypes: 'pulse_align' (zero-aligned short pulse + V0/Vslow spans), 'galvanostatic_dqdv' (Q-V + dQ/dV), and 'ragone' (double-log10 energy-power).

origin_native_recipe.pulse_align: Zero-aligned XYXY curves + sequential_blue_red ramp (>5 curves) + horizontal guides & vertical span annotations.
origin_native_recipe.galvanostatic_dqdv: 1x2 linked panels (Q-V & smoothed dQ/dV) with peak vertical guides.
origin_native_recipe.ragone: layer.x.type=2; layer.y.type=2 (Log10) with inward major + log minor ticks enabled.

modes.summary: 2D continuous pseudocolor contour map (e.g. in-situ DRT gamma(tau), operando XRD/Raman) with pure-white zero background blue-red colormap and optional coupled 1D side_panel.

origin_native_recipe.matrix: MBook/MSheet.from_np(z_matrix) [shape (ny, nx)] + xymap=(x1, x2, y1, y2) + template 'CONTOUR' + add_mplot(ms, 0, type=226).

modes.summary: General declarative multi-panel GridSpec & arbitrary multi-layer overlay grammar.

Scatter + regression fit curve (linear / power / poly2) with 95% confidence shaded band. Supports subtype='scatter_fit' (scatter + fit + CI annotation) or 'band_only' (multi-series mean lines + y_low/y_high half-transparent bands). R² and equation auto-annotated.

origin_native_recipe.scatter_fit: Scatter series (line_scatter, line_style=none) + line_band series (y_low/y_high half-transparent fill_alpha=0.20) + text annotation with R² and equation.
origin_native_recipe.band_only: Multiple line_band series each with y_low/y_high CI fill.

modes.summary: EIS Bode plot: 2-row 1-col dual-panel layout. Top panel: |Z| (Ohm) vs Frequency (Hz), log-log axes, X labels hidden, inward log major+minor ticks. Bottom panel: -Phase (deg.) vs Frequency (Hz), log-linear axes, X labels shown. Panels share X axis.

origin_native_recipe.layout: FigureSpec(nrows=2, ncols=1, height_ratios=[1.0,1.0]); panel_top shares x_axis with panel_bot via share_x_with='panel_top'.
origin_native_recipe.axes: Both X: scale=log10, inward ticks, minor_ticks=True. Top Y: scale=log10. Bottom Y: scale=linear.

modes.summary: Statistical distribution chart for parallel-sample group comparisons. Subtypes: 'box_jitter' (default, box + overlaid jitter dots), 'violin_box' (violin + box), 'half_violin' (half-violin). Each series carries raw parallel-sample y array; color from semantic palette.

origin_native_recipe.box_jitter: mark=stat_box_jitter, Origin template BOX+DATA+OVERLAP, one column per group.

modes.summary: 2D matrix heatmap with optional per-cell value labels. series[0] carries matrix_x (column labels), matrix_y (row labels), matrix_z (2D float, rows × cols). Default colormap: diverging_blue_white_red with center_zero=True; alternative: pseudocolor_zero_white.

origin_native_recipe.colormap: diverging_blue_white_red RIFF .pal (center at white #FFFFFF) or pseudocolor_zero_white.

modes.summary: Publication mean±SD/SEM column bars overlaid with jittered individual replicate dots and auto-computed omnibus/post-hoc significance brackets (*, **, ***, ****).

origin_native_recipe.bars_and_dots: mark='bar_dot_error' -> column bars + YErr (plot:=203) + overlaid jittered 2D circle scatter (plot:=201, symbol_kind=2).
origin_native_recipe.brackets: GuideSpec(kind='sig_bracket', x=x1, x2=x2, value=y_bar, tip_drop=tip_drop, label=stars) with automatic top-frame headroom.

modes.summary: Multi-group native OriginPro Violin + quartile box distribution with Okabe-Ito colorblind-safe palette and auto-computed significance brackets.
Differential expression / proteomics Volcano plot (log2FC vs -log10 p/FDR) partitioned into Down (#2B6CB0), NS (#B8C2CC), and Up (#D84B5C) with dashed cutoff lines and top-hit leader callouts.

origin_native_recipe.thresholds_and_callouts: vline at ±fc_cutoff, hline at -log10(p_cutoff), and panel.meta['point_callouts'] leader labels.

modes.summary: Horizontal Forest / ML Ablation 95% confidence interval plot with inverted categorical Y axis (top-to-bottom), vertical null reference line, and formatted CI strings.

origin_native_recipe.forest: LayerSpec(mark='forest_ci') with horizontal [ci_low, ci_high] capped segments + 2D circle point estimates, y1_axis categorical inverted (1..K), dashed vline at null_value.

modes.summary: Multi-pathway DFT / electrocatalysis reaction free-energy step profile (ΔG vs reaction coordinate) with thick horizontal energy plateaus and dashed inter-step connectors.

origin_native_recipe.steps: LayerSpec(mark='energy_step') rendering [i-0.28, i+0.28] solid thick plateaus + [i+0.28, i+0.72] thin dashed connectors across categorical X step_labels.

modes.summary: Single- or multi-compound 4-parameter logistic (4PL) dose-response sigmoid curves on log10 concentration axis with 95% CI bands and IC50 dashed drop-lines.

origin_native_recipe.fit_band: LayerSpec(mark='line_band') per-compound scatter + smooth 4PL curve + type=9 95% CI band, log10 X axis, and IC50 hline/vline guides.

modes.summary: Kaplan-Meier survival curves with Greenwood cloglog 95% CI step bands, vertical right-censor ticks, Mantel-Cox Log-Rank p / Hazard Ratio summary, and tick-aligned Number-at-risk table.

origin_native_recipe.step_curve: LayerSpec(mark='km_step', plot:=200) with set rr -l 11 (Step-Horz) on main survival + type=9 CI bounds + -k 19 vertical censor ticks.
origin_native_recipe.at_risk_table: Compacted main frame + 1:1 X-tick-aligned Number-at-risk page overlay rows below XB.

modes.summary: Multi-model Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC ± Hanley-McNeil 95% CI + Youden optimal operating cutoff) or Precision-Recall (AUPRC + prevalence baseline) curves.

origin_native_recipe.curves: LayerSpec(mark='line_scatter') with AUROC/AUPRC legend labels, dashed diagonal chance / baseline reference, and open-circle optimal cutoff marker.

modes.summary: 1H / 13C / heteronuclear NMR chemical-shift spectrum (inverted ppm X axis, arbitrary-intensity Y axis) with elevated step-integral curves (0.42..0.78 peak headroom) and multiplet peak tags.

origin_native_recipe.spectrum_and_integrals: Inverted quantitative ppm X axis + intensity_arbitrary Y axis + step-integral SeriesSpec curves + multiplet peak_tag / integral label callouts.

modes.summary: Line/scatter or grouped-bar chart with native OriginPro broken X and/or Y axes (AxisSpec.breaks) for bimodal time/concentration/outlier regimes.
Optical / photonic / Arrhenius spectrum with nonlinear formula-linked top X axis (e.g. bottom Wavelength nm <-> top Photon Energy eV via 1239.84193/x, or Temperature K <-> 1000/T).

origin_native_recipe.linked_top_x: layadd userdef:=1 top:=1 linkto:=1 xaxis:=custom x1:=<formula(X1)> x2:=<formula(X2)> + native XT title.

modes.summary: Three-component normalized (A + B + C = 100%) ternary phase / compositional diagram with custom edge/vertex titles and 2D circle markers or tie-lines.
Angular radiation/anisotropy polar plot (subtype='polar', 0..360 deg) or multi-spoke benchmark radar chart (subtype='radar', >=3 spoke categories).

origin_native_recipe.radar: PanelSpec(coord='radar') -> equal-aspect Cartesian concentric N-gon web + closed polygon spokes.

modes.summary: Synchronized K-track vertical borehole / CTD ocean / paleoclimate depth or age profile sharing an inverted Y axis with cross-track shaded horizon bands.

origin_native_recipe.multi_track: 1xK side-by-side linked layers sharing (d_min, d_max) Y axis, Y labels on Track 1 only, max 3 X ticks per track, cross-track horizon bands.

modes.summary: 2D spatial vector quiver field (x, y, u, v) overlaid on an optional 2D scalar pseudocolor contour map (or auto-computed velocity magnitude field).

origin_native_recipe.quiver: Optional contour_pseudocolor MSheet (plot:=226) + XYXY vector worksheet plotted via plot:=218 (VECTXYXY).
